_sql: SELECT organization_id, notice_id, section_id, name, country, raw_identifier FROM organization_mentions WHERE organization_id IN (31615979, 31610859, 31607070, 31597575, 31551025, 31570843, 31539325, 10176394, 31550879, 13873266, 8430538, 9374778, 31538545) AND raw_identifier LIKE 'GB-NHS-00%' LIMIT 100
